design_call: Construct research queries from admitted public atoms. Do not accept arbitrary private prose and do not represent regex redaction as semantic privacy.
proved: fixed fetches have no customer-derived outbound query
company enrichment accepts one bounded company name on its company endpoint
domain lookups accept a bare normalised domain rather than an email or URL
search routes accept two to ten atomic public topic terms rather than sentences, quotations or interview prose
every non-fixed input carries a digest of the public source admission
unknown fields fail closed, so a caller cannot attach an interview answer and have it silently ignored
provider and query-kind mismatches fail closed
prepared requests expose query-minimisation and exact-request digests for the R49 receipt
residual: A digest proves stable admission evidence exists, not that its source was truly public. Runtime admission still needs a separately authorised public-source resolver and auditable provenance.
next_gate: Specify and prove the public-source admission resolver, then connect R50 output to R49 receipts in a dormant composed adapter.
not_authorized: editing or calling live research routes
treating arbitrary private text as safely redacted
external calls, deployment, merge or release
